# Skrivist

> Skrivist (skriv.ist) is a family of calm, distraction-free readers for your own books and comics: Skrivist Books and Skrivist Comics, apps for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and Windows at a one-time $3 each (coming soon), and Armarium, a free, open-source library server you run yourself. There is no Skrivist account, subscription or tracking. The web readers at books.skriv.ist and comics.skriv.ist closed on November 23, 2026; those addresses are the apps' pages now. Made by Gand (https://gand.tr).

## Products

- [Skrivist Books](https://books.skriv.ist/): EPUB and PDF reader app for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and Windows, a one-time $3 purchase, coming soon. OPDS catalogues and Armarium libraries, text size, page colours and typefaces (OpenDyslexic among them), and on phones and tablets your own Dropbox. No account; books stay on the device.
- [Skrivist Comics](https://comics.skriv.ist/): Comic reader app for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and Windows, a one-time $3 purchase, coming soon. Reads CBZ, CBR and PDF, finds the panels and steps through them panel by panel, right to left for manga. Browses OPDS catalogues and Armarium libraries. No account; files never leave the device.
- [Armarium](https://armarium.skriv.ist/): Free, open-source (MIT) library server you run yourself, for books and comics in plain folders or Calibre libraries. No ads, no tracking. Serves OPDS, pairs Skrivist Books and Comics with a QR code, and syncs reading progress with both apps.
